scope: Additive Home Village TH18 reference delta. It extends the active Monolith-L5 reference without rewriting either earlier ledger.
game_version: Super Wall Breaker levels and death-damage values come from the pinned immutable secondary payload; the qualitative detonation contract is from Supercell's 2020 launch note.

official_deltas.behavior: Super Wall Breaker is guaranteed to explode when it reaches its wall target or when it is destroyed before reaching it.

wall_damage_multiplier.note: Explicit derivation from the pinned parent Wall Breaker x40 Wall multiplier; the nested Super Troop payload omits this shared field.

splash_radius_tiles.note: Explicit derivation from the pinned parent Wall Breaker two-tile blast radius; the nested Super Troop payload omits it.

death_splash_radius_tiles.note: Explicit derivation from the pinned parent Wall Breaker two-tile death-blast radius; Supercell separately confirms the Super variant explodes on destruction.

self_destruct_on_attack.note: Official launch note confirms guaranteed detonation on reaching the target.

support.note: Core support covers only the sourced reach-or-destroy detonation contract and inherited parent blast geometry; it does not claim unmeasured wall-selection topology or animation fidelity.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued-only Super Troop with source-declared stats but no executable support
changed_values.replacement: source-derived shared Wall Breaker blast geometry and a primary-sourced reach-or-destroy detonation contract
changed_values.justification: The Supercell launch note supplies the distinct behavior; the frozen parent Wall Breaker record supplies the omitted shared numeric blast fields with explicit derivation.

known_uncertainties: The official source does not specify protected-wall choice, blast timing within a tick, movement collision, animation or damage ordering against simultaneous effects.
The x40 multiplier and two-tile geometry are parent-derived secondary values, not an independently current Super Wall Breaker table.
conclusion: This is an additive versioned reference. The 2026-09-17 ledger and Monolith-L5 delta remain preserved byte-for-byte.
